While your character is aiming a weapon, item and world-object tooltips are not drawn at all (the vanilla card included). Brushing the inventory mid-fight is almost always accidental, and skipping the tooltip keeps the frame cheap when it matters most. Untick to keep tooltips visible while aiming.
Keep the tooltip skin alongside other tooltip frameworks (experimental)

When another tooltip framework (StarlitLibrary etc.) is active, tooltips it owns stay vanilla while others wear the skin - a mixed look. OFF (default): the skin stands down for the whole session the moment such a framework is detected, so every tooltip matches. All information is shown either way. With StarlitLibrary the mixed look also paints the tooltip skin (card body + accent) onto Starlit’s card. EXPERIMENTAL: stacks of several tooltip mods can still collide visually; items whose tooltips thrash are automatically retired to plain vanilla.
